purpose: Teach: サンバ/ボビー/パトリック/クリストファー/リンダ/アーク/アナン/サドル

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがサンバの音楽教室に通われてるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad has taken up samba lessons, you know.
lines.style: Warm, conversational. Soft opening. Gentle tilt upward on the revelation. Speaking aloud her own delight in noticing what her husband is doing. Maternal attention that doesn't hover.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとボビー・チャールトンの伝記読んだよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I read Bobby Charlton's biography together.
lines.style: Bright and direct, no hesitation. Small voice but clear. The pride of having done something grown-up with Dad — not boasting, just reporting something that mattered. Simple joy.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがパトリック先生の本を貸して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad lent you that Patrick book, didn't he.
lines.style: Soft, observant tone. Not quite a question. Yumiko noticing the small bond forming between them, affirming it gently. Warm exhale on the middle words. Slight trailing acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとクリストファーの絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I looked at Christopher's picture book.
lines.style: Quick tempo, eager to share. Open vowels. No apology, no diminishment — just a child reporting something good. Slight lift at the end, inviting her to be glad with him.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがリンダ・ロンシュタットのCD買って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad bought that Linda Ronstadt CD for you.
lines.style: Gentle, almost wonderstruck. Yumiko marveling quietly at her husband's thoughtfulness. Slow pace. Soft emphasis on the gift itself. The tone of someone noticing love in a small action.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとアーク橋見たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I saw the arch bridge together.
lines.style: Immediate, unfiltered excitement. Rapid-fire delivery without rushing. Sho is bubbling over with things to report. Natural child rhythm — present tense enthusiasm. Slight breathiness.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがアナン氏の伝記をお買いになったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad bought a new bicycle saddle, didn't he.
lines.style: Quieter, more reflective. Yumiko observing the domestic detail — not romantic, but solid. Practical tenderness. She's noticing how Dad takes care of things. Very gentle close.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと自転車のサドル買い替えに行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I went to replace the bike saddle.
lines.style: Warm, satisfied closure. Sho's voice settling into contentment. He's listing the ordinary moments with Dad like treasures. Slight slow-down at the end. The quiet pride of inclusion.
